text:
marc: Heads-up from NimbusMarket: they saw a ~ $7.2k negative adjustment after our marketplace rollup. They suspect late minute deltas collapsed into hourly buckets and our rounding pushed the ledger negative. tagging partners/ops.

tanya: can we fetch the raw minute payloads for the window? if they're sending mixed-mode (increments + snapshots) ordering will bite us.

ode: looked at sample -> Nimbus sends frequent incrementals + occasional full hour snapshots. several snapshots arrived 3-8h late. our hourly merge applies events in arrival order which can flip sign.

nate: do snapshots carry sequence metadata? if so we can prefer snapshots atomically; if not we need tombstones.

marc: right now impact = disputed credits + risk of partner escalation. short-term we should hold snapshots that are older than current hour by >2h and surface to partnerships channel.

tanya: long-term: tombstone approach keyed by (partner_id, window_start, snapshot_id) + rollup honor precedence. also add a dry-run backfill job to compute ledger deltas before applying.

ode: quick estimates from a 60d sample: ~1.4k hour-windows affected, ~0.08 batch-hours to recompute, ledger delta ~ $7.4k. small enough to backfill after partner sign-off.

recon-bot: created ticket PRJ-7810: "nimbus-hourly-snapshot-reconcile" assigned to @ode. (https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-7810) :robot_face:

nate: owners/next steps:
- ode: PR for tombstone ingestion + dry-run backfill job (ETA 48h)
- tanya: run full 60d sample + produce partner CSV (ETA 24h)
- marc: draft partner message + legal review (ETA 24h)

tanya: also adding ingestion alert: if out-of-order snapshot ratio >0.25% for a partner in 24h, block auto-apply and page oncall.

marc: will schedule a short sync with NimbusMarket tomorrow 10:30am PT to review the playbook. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
